cards.ex: I studied hard, but I still fell short of getting an A.
cards.exUz: Men qattiq o'qidim, lekin baribir A bahoni olishga yetishmadim.
cards.uzDef: Kutilgan natijaga erisha olmaslik, maqsadga yetmaslik.

cards.ex: This job is just a stepping stone to a better career.
cards.exUz: Bu ish faqat yaxshiroq kareraga erishish uchun tramplin.
cards.uzDef: Katta maqsadga erishish uchun qilingan kichik qadam.

cards.ex: It's tough to lose, but we need to bounce back for the next game.
cards.exUz: Mag'lubiyatga uchrash qiyin, lekin keyingi o'yin uchun tiklanishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklardan keyin tezda o'ziga kelmoq, qayta oyoqqa turmoq.

cards.ex: I've hit a wall with my writing; I can't seem to come up with new ideas.
cards.exUz: Men yozuvim bilan devorga urildim; yangi g'oyalar o'ylab topolmayapman.
cards.uzDef: O'sish yoki rivojlanish to'xtab qolishi, qiyinchilikka duch kelish.

cards.ex: If you keep practicing, you'll get somewhere with your music.
cards.exUz: Agar mashq qilishda davom etsangiz, musiqangiz bilan nimagadir erishasiz.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish yo'lida oldinga siljish, muvaffaqiyat qozonish.

cards.ex: It takes time to learn the ropes in a new company.
cards.exUz: Yangi kompaniyada ishlarni o'rganish uchun vaqt kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ish yoki faoliyatni qanday bajarishni o'rganish.

cards.ex: The project suffered a major setback when the funding was cut.
cards.exUz: Loyiha mablag' qisqartirilganda katta to'siqqa duch keldi.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatga erishishga to'sqinlik qiladigan muammo yoki voqea.

cards.ex: She always goes the extra mile for her clients.
cards.exUz: U har doim mijozlari uchun ko'proq harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy talablardan ko'proq harakat qilish, qo'shimcha ish bajarish.

cards.ex: He rose to the occasion and gave a fantastic speech.
cards.exUz: U vaziyatga moslashdi va ajoyib nutq so'zladi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda o'zini yaxshi ko'rsatish, talablarga javob berish.

cards.ex: Mixing alcohol and driving is a recipe for disaster.
cards.exUz: Alkogol ichish va haydash - bu halokat retsepti.
cards.uzDef: Yomon natijaga olib kelishi aniq bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: The experiment failed, so we're back to square one.
cards.exUz: Tajriba muvaffaqiyatsiz tugadi, shuning uchun biz boshiga qaytdik.
cards.uzDef: Hamma narsani qaytadan boshlash kerak bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: If you keep studying like this, you're on the right track to passing the exam.
cards.exUz: Agar shunday o'qishda davom etsangiz, imtihondan o'tish uchun to'g'ri yo'ldasiz.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri yo'nalishda harakat qilmoq, maqsadga yaqinlashmoq.

cards.ex: The presentation missed the mark and didn't impress the clients.
cards.exUz: Taqdimot nishonga ololmadi va mijozlarga ta'sir qilmadi.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erisha olmaslik, kutilgan natijani bermaslik.

cards.ex: Scientists have made a major breakthrough in cancer research.
cards.exUz: Olimlar saratonni tadqiq qilishda katta yutuqqa erishdilar.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan katta muvaffaqiyat, muhim kashfiyot.

cards.ex: He needs to get his act together if he wants to keep his job.
cards.exUz: Agar u ishini saqlab qolmoqchi bo'lsa, o'zini qo'lga olishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zini tartibga solmoq, ishni jiddiy qabul qilmoq.

cards.ex: Losing the game after such hard work was a tough break.
cards.exUz: Shuncha mehnatdan keyin o'yinda yutqazish og'ir zarba bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Omadsizlik, qiyin vaziyat.

cards.ex: We have to succeed; failure is not an option.
cards.exUz: Biz muvaffaqiyatga erishishimiz kerak; muvaffaqiyatsizlik mumkin emas.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatsizlikka yo'l qo'ymaslik, g'alaba qozonish majburiy.

cards.ex: After winning the championship, they felt on top of the world.
cards.exUz: Chempionatda g'alaba qozonganidan keyin ular o'zlarini dunyoning tepasida his qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: O'zini juda baxtli va muvaffaqiyatli his qilish.

cards.ex: The business wasn't doing well, so we decided to cut our losses.
cards.exUz: Biznes yaxshi ketmayotgan edi, shuning uchun biz zararni kamaytirishga qaror qildik.
cards.uzDef: Omadsiz loyihadan voz kechib, yo'qotishlarni kamaytirish.

cards.ex: Investing in education pays off in the long run.
cards.exUz: Ta'limga sarmoya kiritish uzoq muddatda o'zini oqlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida, kelajakda.

cards.ex: His plan to cheat backfired when he got caught.
cards.exUz: Uning aldash rejasi ushlanganda teskari ta'sir qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilgan natijaga teskari natija berish, o'ziga zarar yetkazish.

cards.ex: It was hard at first, but I'm starting to get the hang of coding.
cards.exUz: Avvaliga qiyin edi, lekin men kodlashni o'rgana boshladim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani qanday qilishni o'rganish, o'zlashtirish.

cards.ex: He bit off more than he could chew when he took on three extra projects.
cards.exUz: U uchta qo'shimcha loyihani olganida, ko'p luqma oldi.
cards.uzDef: Qobiliyatidan ko'proq ishga urinmoq, uddalay olmaslik.

cards.ex: I failed the exam, but I'm chalking it up to experience and will try again.
cards.exUz: Men imtihondan o'ta olmadim, lekin men buni tajribaga yozaman va yana urinib ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatsizlikdan saboq olib, tajriba deb qabul qilish.

cards.ex: The new restaurant has been a roaring success since it opened.
cards.exUz: Yangi restoran ochilganidan beri katta muvaffaqiyatga erishdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda katta va kutilmagan muvaffaqiyat.

cards.ex: Even after losing his job, he managed to land on his feet and start a new business.
cards.exUz: Ishdan ayrilganidan keyin ham, u oyoqqa turishga va yangi biznes boshlashga muvaffaq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatdan so'ng yaxshi holatga qaytish, muvaffaqiyatga erishish.

cards.ex: After the new management took over, the company started to go downhill.
cards.exUz: Yangi rahbar kelganidan keyin kompaniya pastga keta boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Yomonlashmoq, sifatini yo'qotmoq, yomon tomonga o'zgarmoq.

cards.ex: She's working hard to make a name for herself in the fashion industry.
cards.exUz: U moda sanoatida nom qozonish uchun qattiq mehnat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: O'z sohasida taniqli bo'lish, hurmatga sazovor bo'lish.

cards.ex: The new CEO hit the ground running and immediately implemented changes.
cards.exUz: Yangi bosh direktor tez boshladi va darhol o'zgarishlarni amalga oshirdi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ishni darhol faol va muvaffaqiyatli boshlash.

cards.ex: Applying for that job was a shot in the dark, but I got it!
cards.exUz: Bu ishga ariza topshirish ko'r-ko'rona urinish edi, lekin men uni oldim!
cards.uzDef: Ehtimoli kam bo'lgan, lekin oxirgi urinish.
